title.zh: 发布真实十二语言大爱元宇宙页面

purpose.en: Replace the non-Chinese-to-English fallback with real locale routes and statically translated public content.
purpose.zh: 移除非中文统一回退英文的问题，改为真实语言路由与静态翻译公共内容。

en: Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, and Hindi open their own final pages.
The public home, header, account entry, footer, document language and metadata follow the selected language.
zh: 日语、韩语、西班牙语、法语、德语、俄语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、阿拉伯语和印地语打开各自最终页面。
公共首页、页眉、账户入口、页脚、文档语言及元数据跟随所选语言。

en: Public home language selector, content, shell, metadata, and saved-language redirect.
Deployment checks and Project release history.
zh: 公共首页语言选择器、内容、外壳、元数据和语言记忆跳转。
部署检查与项目发布历史。

en: Use twelve true locale path segments and build-time static translation dictionaries with no runtime translation requests.
Keep GreatLoveMeta branding, links, independent data, and cloud resources intact.
zh: 使用十二个真实语言路径和构建期静态翻译词典，不发起运行时翻译请求。
保留大爱元宇宙品牌、链接、独立数据及云资源。

en: Complete repository tests, production build, artifact and shared gates pass before publication.
Production Chrome click-through checks verify Japanese, Korean, and Spanish final pages, URL, HTML language, content, shell, selector count, and overflow.
zh: 发布前通过完整仓库测试、生产构建、制品及共享门禁。
生产 Chrome 实际点击检查日语、韩语和西班牙语最终页面、URL、HTML 语言、内容、外壳、语言数量和溢出。

en: Member-created ecosystem records remain in their original source language; this release localizes the public interface without rewriting user data.
zh: 会员创建的生态记录仍保留原始源语言；本次本地化公共界面，不改写用户数据。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, ecosystem destinations, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting true locale routing.
zh: 采用真实语言路由时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、生态目的地、独立数据与云资源。
